title: json: Add Compact option for faster JSON output
description:
Add compact JSON output mode that disables pretty-printing (indentation
and whitespace) for `-T json `and `-T jsonraw` formats.

Performance improvement on 10,000 NGAP packets written to file:
  - Pretty JSON:  55s, 22 GB output
  - Compact JSON: 27s, 2.9 GB output (\~2x faster, \~7.5x smaller)

The speed gain comes from eliminating per-node fprintf calls for
indentation whitespace that dominated I/O syscall overhead.

TShark:
- New `--json-compact` long option (requires `-T json` or `-T jsonraw`)
- Help text and error messaging

GUI:
- New "`Compact (no indentation)`" checkbox in JSON export dialog
- Wired through print_args_t.json_compact for GUI/CLI consistency

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body: This change looks reasonable.  I wonder if you saw print_indent() in print.c ?  I added it to speed up pdml writing (avoiding fprintf() calls) - it calls fputs() on a static buffer full of spaces.
I think it would be good to incorporate this into the `print_args_t` struct so that the GUI could (later, perhaps) also use this option.

+==== JSON Format Options
+
+When JSON is selected as the export format, the "Packet Format" panel shows
+JSON-specific options:
+
+No duplicate keys::
+Merge duplicate keys in a JSON object into a single key whose value is a JSON
+array containing all values.
+
+Compact (no indentation)::
+Output compact JSON without indentation or extra whitespace. This significantly
+reduces output size and improves export performance.
+
+Values::
+Export a name/value pair for each field with the decoded field value.
+
+Raw Bytes::
+Export a name/value pair for each field with the raw hex bytes of its packet data.
